applicationProcess.process_md:
**Step-1:** Applicants have to visit the [official website](https://connect.punjab.gov.in/service/citizenservice/116).
**Step-2**: Click on the "Click to apply services".
**Step-3**: Now login on Digital Punjab portal with Email/Phone number and password. If does have any account then register [here](https://ssocitizen.psegs.in/register)
**Step-4:** Fill out the application form.
**Step-5**: Attach the required documents
**Step-6**: Submit.

applicationProcess.process_md:
**Step-1**: Applicants have to visit the official website and download the [application form](https://punjab.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Dependent-Children-Pension.pdf).
**Step-2**: Fill out the application form.
**Step-3**: Attach required documents.
**Step-4**: Submit the Application Form along with all the documents in the same office or centre from where it was collected.

The Age of Child should be below 21 Years.

schemeContent.briefDescription: Punjab State Government started a pension for Dependent Children of the state.

children.text: The main objective behind launching Dependent Children Pension Scheme is to provide financial security cover to those childrens whose income is not stable due to non availability of his/ her father/ parents. This Scheme is implemented by Social Security and Women & Child Development Department of Punjab Government. Eligible Beneficiary will get Monthly Pension direct to their bank account.
